roman_urdu_transliteration: Talmis teesri ikleem mein se hai, Trablus teesri ikleem mein se hai. Trablus-e-Sham tul unus darja chaalis daqeeqa ka hai, arz paintis darja ka hai. Trablus-e-Maghrib tul chatalees darja ka hai, arz bees darja ka hai. Tarsus chauthi ikleem mein se hai. Taosa panchween ikleem mein se ho Andalus ke shahron mein se hai, shehr-e-qadeem hai. Tarkona panchween ikleem mein se hai, Tara-buzdan chhati ikleem mein se hai. Tul nanway darja ka hai, arz bayalis darja daqeeqa ka hai. Talbshan teesri ikleem mein se hai. Tulaitala panchween ikleem mein hai aur Andalus ke shahron mein hai, yeh bara shehr hai. Tilfaj chauthi ikleem mein se hai aur yeh ek bara shehr tak ke shahron ke do paharon ke darmiyan mein waqie hai. Taleeha chauthi ikleem mein se hai. Tus chauthi ikleem mein se hai. Tul ek sau do darja teen daqeeqa ka hai, arz paintis darja ka hai. Tadun chauthi ikleem mein se hai. Tadaus panchween ikleem mein se hai. Taifra doosri ikleem mein se hai. Tairi teesri ikleem mein se hai. Tayab chauthi ikleem mein se r-ek mauza darmiyan Wasit aur Khuzistan ke hai. Talrasa Qween ikleem mein se hai harf zo-e-mujama. Zafar pehli ikleem mein se hai harf ain-e-muhmala. Aaya chauthi ikleem mein se hai. Tul pethar darja teen daqeeqa ka hai, arz paintis darja ka hai. Abadan teesri ikleem mein se hai. Tul ek sau chaar darja teen daqeeqa ka hai, arz paintis darja ka hai. Abd-al-Abad chauthi ikleem mein se Qazween ke qareeb ek mauza ho, Aden ikleem se kharij hai. Tul petar darja ka hai, arz ghyarah darja ka hai. Urt teesri ikleem mein se ho, Urqa chauthi ikleem mein se hai. Anaqa chauthi ikleem mein se hai. Asqalan Filisteen tul chasath darja teen daqeeqa ka hai, arz paintis darja pandrah daqeeqa ka hai. Askar-e-Karam tul pachis darja teen daqeeqa ka hai, arz battis darja pandrah daqeeqa ka hai. Eedan doosri ikleem mein se hai. Ain Shams teesri ikleem mein se hai aur yeh Jafar ko gird-o-nawah mein so daryai ke kinari par waqie hai. Ain Haara teesri ikleem mein se hai aur yeh Halab ka ek mauza hai. Utiqman chauthi ikleem mein se hai harf ghain-e-mujama. Ghameekhana Qalaimun se kharij hai aur yeh Suwan ke shahron mein surkh khat istwa junub ki janib waqie hai. Gharaza teesri ikleem mein se ho. Ghiras teesri ikleem mein se hai. Ghurna chauthi ikleem mein se ek mauza Khurasan ka hai. Ghura chauti ikleem mein se Khurasan mein ek mauza hai. Harf fa pehli ikleem mein se hai aur yeh Maghrib ko bilad mein se hai. Faalis doosri ikleem mein se subha ka hai.
